'''Zeethreeone''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] that, under the control of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Stipling]], was assigned the task of finding a source of the metal alloy [[Doonium/Legends|doonium]] on [[Yen-2]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was destroyed by [[Limna Yith]], during [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun's]] attempt to overrun the [[Yen-2]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation.
